train-walker-frames.alt: A train moves to the right at +20.0 m/s relative to the ground. Inside, a passenger walks toward the front at +1.5 m/s relative to the train. An observer stands on the platform. The walker's velocity relative to the ground is 1.5 m/s + 20.0 m/s = +21.5 m/s; walking toward the back at 1.5 m/s would give +18.5 m/s.
